evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rising monotonically through growth: 6.5 → 12.3 → 16.2 → 19.5 → 25.7 ppm after purging to ~4 ppm, suggesting air ingress
Pressure gauge not installed, so tube atmosphere/leak cannot be confirmed independently
Temperature holding 750 °C at stable ~46% heater power; thermal control nominal

args.missing_evidence: A tube pressure reading (or an installed gauge) to confirm a leak, plus continued O2 trend; a leak-check/valve-isolation test would discriminate seal leak from sensor drift
